label: Leboncoin Scraper
title: Leboncoin Scraper: leboncoin.fr Listings to JSON & CSV
metaDescription: Scrape any leboncoin.fr search URL: price, location, seller, photos and every category attribute (surface, rooms, energy rating, mileage, fuel).
intro: Paste any leboncoin.fr search link and get each ad's price, location, seller, photos and every category-specific attribute, such as surface, rooms and energy rating for property, or mileage and fuel for cars.
useCases: Track second-hand car prices in France
Watch new property ads in a city
Research resale prices for a product category

faq.q: Is there an official Leboncoin API?
faq.a: Leboncoin does not offer a public API for searching listings. This actor works from public search pages: paste the search URL and get structured data back, also through the Apify API.
